full_judgment: 17. Now coming to the case before us and on perusal of the law mentioned above it thus appears that the legislature in its wisdom did not mandate that in order to be selected for a licence of Nikah Registrar the incumbent is to be a permanent resident of an area. Only criteria required to be attained is that the incumbent should be a 'resident' of the area. It is not denied that in the application for appointment the appellant mentioned his address at Ayesha Fakirair Bari, Moulaipara, Uttar Agrabad, Chittagong within the jurisdiction of the area of Ward No. 24 Agrabad under Chittagong City Corporation and in support thereof voter's list finally published on 7-10-1995 of Ward No.24 containing the name of the appellant in the said address was also there.
